title: Kenya Family Safari
headline: A Nairobi night, then a family camp and drives that can end early.
description: Six nights in Kenya for families: one city night, then a Mara lodge that actually takes children, with drives shortened if they need to be.
image_alt: African elephants walking across open savanna
price_label: Quoted for your family and season
price_guidance: Family safari pricing depends on camp child policy, room type and season. Some camps have a minimum age. Park fees and international flights sit outside the base figure unless you ask us to include them.
overview: A first family safari that does not pretend every child wants a 5 a.m. start. We shortlist Mara camps that take your children’s ages, keep a Nairobi night for the long flight, and let drives end when the youngest has had enough.
highlights: A family-accepting Mara camp for five nights.
Game drives that can be shortened.
Optional balloon only if ages and the camp allow it.
why: Camp chosen for child policy first, not brochure photos.
One safari base — no daily lodge-hop.
Dietary needs sent to camp before you land.
inclusions: Airport and lodge transfers as quoted
Meals at the safari camp as the plan includes them
Accommodation on family-room or adjoining tents as quoted
exclusions: Park fees if they are not itemised in the quote
Balloon safari and extra activities unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

stay.name: Selected Nairobi hotel and family-friendly Mara camp
stay.room: Family tent, adjoining rooms or twins as the camp allows
amenities: Wi-Fi where the camp offers it

notes: Minimum ages, camp and vehicle type are confirmed in writing. Wildlife sightings are never guaranteed. An inquiry is not a booking.
itinerary_note: A Nairobi night plus a Mara stay. Some camps cannot take children under a set age.
